question: Which of the following is a perennial herbaceous plant in the nightshade family Solanaceae that is used in alternative medicine as an aid in treating arthritis pain, colds, or hay fever?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atropa belladonna.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atropa belladonna** is a **perennial herbaceous plant** in the nightshade family **Solanaceae.**
 
• It is commonly known as a deadly nightshade and is native to **Europe, North Africa, and Western Asia.**
 
• In alternative medicine, **Atropa belladonna **is used as an aid in treating **arthritis pain,** colds, or hay fever due to its anti-inflammatory properties.
 
• However, it is important to note that Atropa belladonna is **highly toxic** and can cause **serious health problems **if consumed in large amounts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arachis hypogaea** is the scientific name for **peanuts**.

 
 
• They are a **legume crop** that is widely cultivated for their **edible seeds.**
 
 
 
• **Cynodon dactylon** is a perennial grass that is commonly known as **Bermuda grass**.
 
 
• It is often used as a **turf grass **in warm climates.
 
 
 
• **Cicer arietinum** is the scientific name for **chickpeas**.
 
 
• They are a legume crop that is widely cultivated for their **edible seeds.**
 
 
 
• It is important to note that none of these options are used in alternative medicine for **treating arthritis pain, colds or hay fever.**
